answer: Peers then rate agents on private tasks, and a prism separates consistent signal from a whisper of collusive noise. A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each new agent to lock a stake that decays with the tide of epoch rewards, so identity farming costs real capital. Newcomers must earn a quorum of distinct, staked attestations prior to their votes count, making mass fake identities expensive and slow to bootstrap while honest agents stay cheap. In practice, Agent0058 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
